race.comment: Huge test for the punters here - this is tough. AUTUMNHEAT (17) has been very strong winning his past two from the front over 2400m, dominant in the end at Caulfield in a BM84. More depth here but he gets in with 53kg and hits this in form and on the up which not many can claim. TEMPESTI (4) is one of those, winless in 14 starts in Australia. He was having his first run for the Bedggood yard in the G3 ATC St Leger and ran very well behind Melbourne Cup fancy So You Are. That's clearly the best form in the race and perhaps he's turned a corner for the sharp yard. ATHABASCAN (2) was 4th in the ATC St Leger when working home fairly well. Drawn very wide here but his best is good enough. JENNIVAMOOSE (5) has had excuses her past couple. Her prior form around Shockletz and Saint George is excellent for this and Zahra goes on from a middle gate. LEONCHROI (20) was favourite to beat AUTUMNHEAT last time and could improve.
